description: This file defines the Link2 class, which models a relationship link from a single bean's perspective in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It manages relationship loading, querying, adding, removing, and related bean retrieval, and interacts with relationship objects and bean factory methods.

classes.name: Link2
classes.description: Represents a relationship link from a single bean's perspective, handling relationship loading, querying, bean management, and relationship metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Link2 object, determining relationship definitions and instantiating the relationship object.

methods.name: loadedSuccesfully
methods.description: Checks if the relationship was successfully loaded.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads relationship data based on provided parameters.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a relationship query using the relationship object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns IDs of related records, loading data if necessary.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related module.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleLinkName
methods.description: Returns the link name used on the related module side.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the relationship type ('many' or 'one').

methods.name: getFocus
methods.description: Returns the parent SugarBean this link references.

methods.name: getRelatedFields
methods.description: Returns related fields metadata.

methods.name: getRelatedField
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific related field.

methods.name: getRelationshipObject
methods.description: Returns the relationship object.

methods.name: getSide
methods.description: Determines if the link is on the LHS or RHS of the relationship.

methods.name: isParentRelationship
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is a parent relationship.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Returns join query for this link.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns a query to fetch related record IDs.

methods.name: getSubpanelQuery
methods.description: Returns a subpanel query for related records.

methods.name: getBeans
methods.description: Retrieves related SugarBean objects, loading from database if necessary.

methods.name: beansAreLoaded
methods.description: Checks if beans are already loaded.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a relationship between the focus bean and other beans.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes relationships with specified beans.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the relationship for a given record pair.

methods.name: getRelatedBean
methods.description: Retrieves a related SugarBean by ID.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic getter for relationship_type, _relationship, beans, and rows.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic setter for beans property.

methods.name: addBean
methods.description: Adds a bean to the relationship's loaded beans.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Removes a bean from the relationship's loaded beans.
